newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 20.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 20.125 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates were little changed on Thursday in tight liquidity as large amounts must have been tied up with the central bank's reverse repo facility, traders said.
Overnight rates traded between 20.125 and 20.375 percent and closed at 20.125 percent, unchanged from Wednesday's close.
"The market was balanced but somewhat expensive compared to benchmark interest rates," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
The central bank's one-week reverse repo facility, currently at 20.00 percent, is considered the benchmark level for Hungary's interbank overnight market.
